release_notes:
feat(orders): quantity from line-count for UseAsQuantity text fields

Extend UseAsQuantity so a multi-line custom field can drive the order
quantity by its non-empty line count, within a single order (price x N),
instead of requiring a typed number. Enables supplier any-qty services
such as PaidUnlock case-history removal, where one order carries N case
IDs, one per line, and the full list is sent to the supplier.

- ajximeiorder.php: select UseAsQuantity; render such a field as a tall
  textarea with a live-price hook and a hidden useAsQty flag.
- placeimeiorder.php: derive ORDER_QTY from the non-empty line count.
- submitimeiorder.php: multiply the package price by ORDER_QTY.
- imeiorder.js: gfCalcQtyPrice live total = unit x line-count.

Per-field and additive: only fields flagged UseAsQuantity=1 are affected;
all other text fields are unchanged.

(cherry picked from commit f62ddcccf78fd1e30cf33740bcd4d62cd3d40d00)
